0022600135.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (2-1, fifth in the East) for the 76ers' fifth game of the 2026-27 season, and the Pacers are second in the Central, one game back. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, but Philadelphia won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 105-94 regular-season win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026. Out for Philadelphia are Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (heel), and VJ Edgecombe (abdomen, bruise) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Indiana is without Andrew Nembhard (back soreness), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain).
